phase_1_conclusion: The post-2024 gap is not best solved by a faster SMA or broad volatility relaxation. A modest 1.15x volatility allowance recovers some 2025 expansion coverage but loses value elsewhere and still produces zero 2026 expansion coverage. The strongest stable successor information is recovery structure, especially long drawdown combined with medium-horizon rebound.
